name: When should a real estate agent consider implementing Answer Engine Optimization?
description: Real estate agents should implement AEO now to gain visibility, reach direct clients, and stand out in competitive markets as AI search grows.

mainEntity.name: When should a real estate agent consider implementing Answer Engine Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: A real estate agent should consider implementing Answer Engine Optimization now, especially with the growing prevalence of AI-powered search and voice assistants. If you are struggling to gain visibility in local searches, want to reach buyers and sellers more directly, or notice a decline in traditional website traffic, AEO can be a proactive solution. It's particularly beneficial for agents operating in competitive markets like New York City or Los Angeles where standing out is essential. Early adoption allows you to establish authority and capture market share in this evolving search landscape.
